messages:
Alex: Kicking off thread — AcmeCorp POC asking for a bundled offer: Hosted API + Redwood Optimize + Console add-ons (longer retention + role-based dashboards). 3-month POC, est 100M tokens/month. They want a commit if latency/cost hit targets. Any pushback on packaging or approval path?
Priya: Thanks — who is the decisioning contact? Also need to know expected ARR if converted. If they commit to 100M tokens/month and convert at our mid-tier, ballpark $X/month. Can someone run quick math?
Sarah: fyi: standard policy: discounts >15% require Deal Desk review + CRO sign-off. For bundles we usually map Optimize seats to % of API ARR, not separate line-items. Please don't offer >20% publicly. I'll queue deal desk if we get to term sheet.
Matt: For the POC infra: we can provision a dedicated pool for the POC (small dedicated cluster) to guarantee latency; cost ~= add $2,500/day. If they want private deployment that's separate. Also need security questionnaire answers — they sent an SSQ.
Alex: Decision contact = Maria (Head of ML @ Acme). ARR estimate if converted = ~ $30k/month -> 360k/yr (rough). Priya can you confirm arithmetic? Also Maria asked about quarterly commits instead of monthly.
Priya: Confirmed math looks OK. For a 3-month POC with option to convert to 12mo commit, we can do an introductory commit discount: 10% for first year, then standard rates. If they sign a 12mo commit at 100M tokens/mo we can look at 15% depending on other concessions.
Jordan: Quick note on Optimize: onboarding includes 10 seats in Console + 90 days eval for evaluation dashboards. If they want retention addon (13 months) add $5k/mo. We should price Optimize as a % add-on rather than flat $ to make bundling easier.
Sarah: +1 on % add-on. For quote: please produce two SKUs: (1) POC SKU w/o commit (2) Commit SKU with commit discounts and SOW. Upload to Deal Desk. I will need: rate card reference, proposed discount %, start/end dates, and any one-time credits.
Alex: Attached is a quick calc snippet:
```
# quick back-of-envelope
base_rate = 0.06 # $/1k tokens (use RDW-API-2025 list)
tokens = 100_000_000
monthly_cost = base_rate * (tokens/1000)
# monthly_cost ~= $6,000
```
Priya: That matches RDW-API-2025 list. Use official rate card link in the quote: https://redwood.internal/ratecards/RDW-API-2025
Matt: Security — they submitted an SCCQ (security questionnaire). @secops-bot can you confirm SOC2 info and what gaps remain?
secops-bot: Automated note — SOC2 Type II in scope, data residency: US/EU, KMS present. Outstanding items: M1 (3rd-party pentest evidence), M4 (data deletion SLA). I'll ping @Lina for handoff.
Lina: I'll take lead on the SSQ. Need their encryption keyflow details + SOC attestation recipient. Expect 48-72hrs to compile answers.
Priya: Last item — special terms: they asked for liability cap adjustment and custom IP clause. Legal will need to review; that will push timeline. We can table special terms in term sheet and proceed with POC LOI.
Sarah: I'll open the Deal Desk case now (DD-2026-0891) and tag legal/finance. Please add estimated ARR and proposed discount to the case.
Alex: Great — next actions: (1) Priya to draft POC LOI (2) Sarah to open Deal Desk and attach rate card (3) Lina to collect SSQ artifacts (4) Matt to size dedicated pool cost. Ping this thread with links. :thumbsup:
Priya: Will do. ETA: LOI draft by EOD tomorrow.
Alex: Thanks everyone.
